spans.s:
अदेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Improper or unfit to be given.
 E. अ neg. देय to
be given.

आदेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Receivable, leviable, what may be taken or re-
ceived.
 E. आङ् before दा to give, यत् aff.

अदेयदान n. (-नं) Giving what ought not to be given, what is not
one's own, &c.
 E. अदेय, and दान giving.

आदेवक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) One who sports or plays.
 E. आङ् before दिन to
sport, वुञ् aff.

आदेश m. (-शः)
 1. An order, a command.
 2. Advice, instruction.
 3. (In
grammar,) A substitute.
 4. (In astrology,) Event, result, conse-
quence of stellar conjunctions, &c.
 E. आङ् before दिश् to point or
show, घञ् aff.

आदेशिन् m. (-शी)
 1. A commander, a director.
 2. An astrologer, a for-
tune-teller.
 E. आङ् before दिश to point or show, and णिनि aff.

आदेष्टृ m. (-ष्टा)
 1. An adviser, a director, a commander.
 2. An employer
of priests.
 E. आङ् before दिश to show, तृच् aff.
